_comment: Committed on purpose: every clone gets the same grants and a reviewer can read them.
An entry ending in `:*` is a prefix match. An open `git fetch` wildcard is
deliberately absent, because git's ext:: transport turns a fetch url into a command.
There is no build or test step in this repository - it is hand-written static HTML -
so the grants are read-only git inspection, the page generator, and the two tools
/verify actually runs: tidy (read-only validity check) and python3's built-in static
server. `npx --yes serve` is deliberately NOT granted and /verify no longer uses it:
npx downloads a package and runs its lifecycle scripts, which is a person's decision
in every other repository in this family and should not be routine here either.
Keep these matching the commands /verify names - a near-miss silently prompts.
